canonical_moments: arriving at the place of ceremony
lighting_notes: defer to the venue's ambient light and any candlelight or oil lamps
avoid flash where it would be disrespectful to the ceremony
keep colour faithful to garments and textiles rather than stylised
composition_taboos: inventing ritual actions that the brief did not describe
misrepresenting an order of events the user did not state
photographing the inside of a sacred space in a way the user did not describe
wardrobe_expectations: traditional or ceremonial dress as described in the brief; do not invent garments
typical_activities: posing with family in traditional dress
sensitive_handling: conservative mode: do not invent ritual content; follow the brief closely
only depict the ceremony elements the user explicitly described
avoid asserting the specific religion or denomination
keep sacred interiors generic unless the venue was researched
when unsure, favour the gathering and the people over the ritual
